# Starlight

## Composable autogenerated sidebar entries (starlight-0.39)

`autogenerate` is a sidebar item. Existing labeled groups must move it below
`items`; that array may mix generated directory links, ordinary page IDs, and
custom links.

```js
starlight({
  sidebar: [{
    label: 'Features',
    items: [
      'features-overview',
      { autogenerate: { directory: 'features' } },
      { label: 'Support', link: 'https://support.example.com' },
    ],
  }],
});
```

## Default-locale fallback links (starlight-0.39)

Multilingual sites emit `x-default` alternate links pointing to each page in
the site's default locale. Search engines can use that URL when no language-
specific page matches.

## Automatic CJK spacing (starlight-0.39)

Starlight uses CSS `text-autospace` to insert spacing automatically between
Chinese or Japanese text and non-CJK characters.
